description: A shell script that orchestrates restarting, rebuilding, signing, packaging, and launching the OpenClaw application on macOS. It includes processes such as killing existing instances, building the app, handling code signing, managing launch agents, and starting the app with environment configurations.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Prints a message to stdout with a newline.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints an error message to stderr and exits the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary lock directory if it exists.

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent concurrent restarts, waits if needed.

methods.name: stop_launch_agent
methods.description: Stops the OpenClaw launch agent via launchctl.

methods.name: kill_all_openclaw
methods.description: Kills all running instances of OpenClaw and related processes.

methods.name: choose_app_bundle
methods.description: Selects or verifies the application bundle path.
